items.text: §1 Decisions-required gate: operator sign-off before Wave 0 dispatch (the decisions that gate the whole portfolio)

Wave 0 substrate cleanup: dedupe Attestation entry type (remove imagodei duplicate, elohim DNA copy is single source); migrate imagodei coordinator paths to call elohim DNA coordinator; land 10 elohim_event_type + 5 Attestation discriminators on a clean substrate

Wave 1 commitment factory + tier-state projection: 10 quilt-* elohim_event_type values; 5 new economic_events columns (tier_from/tier_to/shelf_destination_uri/driver_class/cost_class); quilt_tier_state table (Category C projections, no DHT entry-type change)

Wave 2 TierController + LocalDeviceDriver + heuristic classifier: StorageBackend trait (execute_transition/driver_class/advertise_cost_class) + TierController orchestration + heuristic tier classifier

Wave 3 ShelfRouter + ExternalArchiveDriver + quilt-s3-shim + sccache repoint: URI-scheme dispatch (peer-cellar/external-archive) two-phase commit; MinIO driver via aws-sdk-s3; S3 shim; repoint sccache to quilt
Wave 4 BreachScanner (absorbs Plan 2): Pass 1 observation gap (cheap, walks commitments+holdings, tier-breach below floor) + Pass 2 sampled direct draw probe
Wave 5 Restitutor (absorbs Plan 3): subscribes BreachWitnessed signal; deterministic arbitration argmin(blake3(breach_hash||peer_id||epoch))
Wave 6 HoldingsAttester + AccountingAggregator (absorbs Plan 4): periodic tier-holdings Attestation (archetype-tuned cadence) reading quilt_tier_state + economic_events; accounting aggregation
Wave 7 chaos demo + dogfood a2o (absorbs Plan 5): end-to-end chaos demonstration + a2o scenarios proving the tiered-quilt stewardship loop
Parallel tracks: A driver backlog, B app-manifest evolution, C doc+memory updates, D CI integration (run alongside waves not as waves)
Acceptance gates between waves (§5) + dependency graph (§4) + risk register (§6); all 8 sub-plan files not yet authored
